title: SCARED Rating Scale
description: Screen for childhood anxiety disorders. Parent and child versions.
instructions: Below is a list of statements that describe how people feel. Read each statement carefully and decide if it is "Not True or Hardly Ever True", "Somewhat True or Sometimes True" or "Very True or Often True" for your child. Then, for each statement, select the response that seems to describe your child for the last 3 months. Please respond to all statements as well as you can, even if some do not seem to concern your child.

scared3.label: Not True or Hardly Ever True

bands.label: Indicated
bands.interpretation: May indicate Panic Disorder or significant somatic symptoms

total.label: Possible anxiety disorder
total.interpretation: A total score of 25 or more may indicate the presence of an anxiety disorder.

total.label: Possible anxiety disorder (more specific)
total.interpretation: Scores higher than 30 are more specific.
